document_metadata.title: 1、INT. FIRST FUNERAL PARLOR - DAY
document_metadata.summary: A man gives a widow his business card disguised as a condolence gesture, hinting at legal assistance, after receiving money from another attendee at a funeral.

entities.name: Working-Class Funeral
entities.description: A modest funeral service attended by about thirty people, centered around a simple bier, where mourners gather to pay respects to the deceased and offer condolences to the bereaved family.

entities.description: An attorney introduced by the funeral director to Mrs. Dee, who offers his condolences and hands her his business card in a gesture resembling giving money.

document_metadata.summary: Dr. Towler testifies about Deborah Kaye's 1970 delivery, explaining she aspirated vomit, leading to cardiac arrest, and his team's efforts to save her and the baby despite complications.

entities.name: Deposition Rehearsal For Deborah Ann Kaye Case
entities.description: A formal preparation session in a conference room where Concannon rehearses Dr. Towler's testimony with his legal team present, simulating a deposition for an upcoming trial.
entities.summary: A formal preparation session in a conference room where Concannon rehearses Dr. Towler's testimony with his legal team present, simulating a deposition for an upcoming trial.

entities.description: Dr. Towler recounts the emergency medical procedure initiated when Deborah Ann Kaye's heart stopped during delivery, including Dr. Marx creating an airway and the team's resuscitation efforts.

entities.description: Concannon challenges Kathy regarding a contradiction between her current testimony that the patient ate one hour before treatment and the medical chart she signed four years ago indicating the patient ate nine hours prior.

entities.description: The Judge overrules Concannon's immediate objection, stating he will rule on the admissibility of the photocopy later, and instructs the proceedings to continue.

entities.name: Defense team begins researching legal response to new evidence
entities.description: Following the Judge's decision, Concannon signals to Billy, who begins coordinating with other defense lawyers to consult legal references in response to Kathy's unexpected evidence.

entities.description: Kathy reveals under questioning that after Deborah Ann Kaye went into a coma, Dr. Towler admitted he was exhausted, had not reviewed the admittance form, and instructed her to change the meal time from 'one hour' to 'nine hours' or face termination.
